rule: KERNEL dot: every 1-C below is replaced by D=|x_i-x_j|^2/2 of unnormalized flattened activations divided by the probe-centred mean squared norm (SPEC_DOT.md); kappa therefore has units of 1/D. Cosine distance 1-C; midpoint medians. 0: union 15NN, weight1 on edges,1e-6 elsewhere, zero diagonal. 1/2: per-row conditional perplexity100/300 then symmetric mean affinity. 3: kappa=1/median15th-neighbour distance. 4: calibrate median raw nonself15NN mass=.5. All: log-domain symmetric scaling P of zero-diagonal affinity, M=(I+P)/2. kappa/q10/q90 are null for graph, per-point quantiles for perplexity, identical scalars for modes3/4. self_weight is null for modes0–2, retained-vMF Sinkhorn median diagonal for3/4. nn_mass uses each actual symmetric pre-Sinkhorn kernel.
modes_note: rules 2-4 not shipped (site size cap 800 MB)
layouts_note: seed 0 and spectral only (no seed-1 dot layout); seed 0 rotated onto the cosine seed-0 layout
